headline: Continued hearings on projects at 61-69 Suffolk, 230-232 Beech, and 956 Dwight streets, and 120 Pine Street
summary: Two lot division plans, on Charles Hill Road and Sun Valley Road, were approved. A proposed native plants zoning change was continued to November 10 so members can meet with Councilor Meg Magrath-Smith. Hearings on parking, zone change, and fence height requests were continued to October 27, 2026.
decisions: Continued the parking special permit for 61-69 Suffolk Street to October 27, 2026, 5-0.
Continued discussion of the Notice of Decision for a fence height special permit at 230-232 Beech Street to October 27, 2026.
Continued the parking special permit for 956 Dwight Street to October 27, 2026, 5-0.
Continued the zone change for 120 & 0 Pine Street, from BL to BH, to October 27, 2026.
Continued the native plants zoning text change to November 10, 2026, 5-0.
Approved the ANR for a rear lot division on Charles Hill Road, parcels 29, 35, and 36, 5-0.
Approved the ANR for a parcel join on Sun Valley Road, parcels 136 and 137, 5-0.
Continued approval of the minutes of 3/28/2023, 4/9/2024, 5/14/2024, and 4/23/2024 to October 27, 2026, 5-0.
Scheduled the next major review for November 10 and a tentative meeting for December 1 or 15.

decision_evidence.quote: Special Permit cont (Sec 6.1.7) Reduction of Parking Requirements – Bryan Taub ~ 61-69 Suffolk St (SP 2026-14) The Board voted in the hearing to continue until October 27, 2026, when the applicant can gather more information on the correct calculations for the Board.

Special Permit cont (Sec 4.6.3.2) Exceed Fence Height – Rafael & Sheila Rivera, 230-232 Beech Street (SP 2026-7) The Board reviewed the draft Notice of Decision, they continued the discussion until October 27, 2026, to allow staff to work on the Notice of Decision and Kate Kruckemeyer to review.

Special Permit cont (Sec 6.1.7) Reduction of Parking Requirements – Zachery Scott ~ 956 Dwight St (SP 2026-15) The Board voted to continue until October 27, 2026, due to applicant not being present for the meeting.
Zone Change cont John Borowski, 120 & 0 Pine Street (006-09-018), BL to BH (ZC 2026-9) The Board voted to continue until October 27, 2026, due to applicants not being present for the meeting.

Zone Change cont (2/3/26 MAGRATH) Native Plants (ZC 2026-4) The Board voted in the hearing to continue until November 10, 2026, to allow planning board members to speak with Councilor Meg Magrath-Smith.
ANR Charles Hill Road (168-00-029) Jeffery Burkott explained the ANR, by stating a rear lot division on Charles Hills Road involving parcels 29, 35, and 36, and the Board voted to approve.

ANR Sun Valley Road (181-00-0136/181-00-137) Jeffery Burkott explained a parcel join on Sun Valley Road involving parcels 136 and 137, the Board voted to approve the ANR, but though the Sun Valley case included a note that the board's approval doesn't guarantee zoning or wetlands status. The motion carried 5-0 by roll call vote
The Board voted to approve 11/12/2024, 7/28/26, 8/25/2026, and 9/8/2026 The motion was made by Kate Kruckemeyer and seconded by Paul Burns-Johnson. The motion carried 5-0 by roll call vote

The Board voted to continue 3/28/2023, 4/9/2024, 5/14/2024, 4/23/2024 until October 27, 2026. The motion was made by Kate Kruckemeyer and seconded by Paul Burns-Johnson. The motion carried 5-0 by roll call vote
The Board scheduled their next major review for November 10th and confirmed a tentative meeting for December 1st or 15th, depending on readiness.
